worldcombat.skill.conversion.summary: Reads the type of the first move in the moveset and temporarily reweaves the body into that type.
worldcombat.skill.conversion.use.1: Reweave the body into that type
worldcombat.skill.conversion.description: Scans its own moveset and completes the reweave after %1$s; it does not fire when the body already has that type or an ability locks its type.
The body's original types are replaced by that type for %1$s; type matchups, same-type bonus and status immunities all read the new type, and the original types return when it ends.
